name: param-uq-00-screen
title: Parameter screen — which config-reachable knobs actually drive the observables?
claim:
Of the top-level process-config knobs reachable via `baseline()` config_overrides,
only 3 produce a real change in growth rate; the rest are inert.
question:
Among the top-level `ecoli-*` process-config scalars, which actually change the
growth observables when perturbed (so they're worth including in the UQ)?

report.title: param-uq-00-screen — parameter screen for UQ-eligible config knobs
report.evidence_quality: low/high sweep per knob, 120-step window, 7 candidates screened
report.objective:
Before investing in a full PCE-based UQ (param-uq-01), identify which
top-level `ecoli-*` process-config scalars actually change the simulation's
growth observables. This avoids wasting surrogate budget on inert parameters
and ensures the effective parameter surface is well-defined.
report.setup:
Method: vary each candidate knob between a "low" and "high" bound (physically
meaningful range) with a FRESH initial_state (v2ecoli PR #197) to prevent
state-carryover. Run a 120-step window and measure % change in
`instantaneous_growth_rate` (low → high swing).

Candidate knobs screened (7 total from ecoli-polypeptide-elongation and
ecoli-chromosome-replication process configs).
report.result:
Screen %-response (instantaneous_growth_rate, low→high swing):

| Knob | Path | % response | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| basal_elongation_rate | ecoli-polypeptide-elongation.basal_elongation_rate | 13.8% | EFFECTIVE |
| kS | ecoli-polypeptide-elongation.kS | 5.5% | EFFECTIVE |
| chrom basal_elongation_rate | ecoli-chromosome-replication.basal_elongation_rate | 2.8% | EFFECTIVE |
| k_RelA | ecoli-polypeptide-elongation.k_RelA | 1.4% | inert |
| gtpPerElongation | ecoli-polypeptide-elongation.gtpPerElongation | 0.0% | inert |
| import_threshold | ecoli-polypeptide-elongation.import_threshold | 0.0% | inert |
| D_period | ecoli-chromosome-replication.D_period | 0.0% | inert |

Note: ribosomeElongationRate is inert because it is overwritten at runtime each
step (the config value is ignored). gtpPerElongation only affects energy
accounting and does not move the growth-rate observable. The 3 effective knobs
feed param-uq-01.
report.interpretation:
config_overrides reach only top-level process knobs; most physiological params
live deeper in sim_data and are not reachable by this path (see param-uq-04).
This screen defines the effective UQ surface for the config_overrides path.
The 3 EFFECTIVE knobs (basal_elongation_rate, kS, chrom.basal_elongation_rate)
form the parameter set for param-uq-01-elongation.
report.decision:
PASS — screen complete. 3 of 7 screened knobs show >2% growth-rate response
and are included in the UQ. The inert knobs are excluded from the UQ budget.
See param-uq-04-deep-params for the path to deeper sim_data parameters.

model_settings.name: fresh-initial-state
model_settings.detail: Each low/high perturbation uses a fresh initial_state (v2ecoli PR #197) to prevent state carryover across samples.

model_settings.name: growth-rate-observable
model_settings.detail: Observable = instantaneous_growth_rate; chosen because mass observables do not respond over a 120-step window.

model_settings.name: threshold-2pct
model_settings.detail: Knobs with >2% response are classified EFFECTIVE; ≤1.4% classified inert.

assumptions.text:
config_overrides at the `baseline()` call reach only top-level process-config
scalars. Deep sim_data physiological parameters (kinetic rates, mass fractions)
are not reachable by this path and were not screened here.

A 120-step window (fresh initial_state, ~4% of one generation) is sufficient to
reveal whether a knob has a real effect on instantaneous_growth_rate. Knobs
that modulate slower timescale processes may appear inert at this window.

tests.name: screen-identifies-effective-knobs
tests.question:
Do at least 2 of the 7 screened config-reachable knobs show a >2% response
in instantaneous_growth_rate (i.e., is the UQ parameter surface non-trivial)?

measure.detail:
3 of 7 screened knobs show >2% growth-rate response (basal_elongation_rate
13.8%, kS 5.5%, chrom.basal_elongation_rate 2.8%). Measured value = 3
effective knobs identified.
